sb_hint: AP pool and caps for character creation: ap = total points. Counting starts at attrBase (or attribute min). maxAttrTotal = sum of all attributes, maxAttrValue = single maximum, maxSkillValue = skill maximum (additionally capped by highest involved attribute +2 if configured), fatePoints = starting fate points.
sb_curve: Default cost curve (up to value → AP per point)
sb_save_blocked: Over budget — reduce costs before saving
st_hint: Catalog of advantages/disadvantages (each with costs/tiers). requires/excludes govern combinations. Effects: derived:name (e.g. derived:hp = bonus to a derived value) or attribute:name, op add — they apply automatically once the trait is chosen. Description explains the rules effect to players (tooltip text).
sa_hint: Costs per column and target value. Skills pick a column; activation costs apply at value 0. Columns (A/B/…) are pure price tiers: table with from/to plus costs per column — each skill references exactly one.
v_need_attributes: Add at least one attribute before saving
s2_hint: Define the core attributes of your system (e.g. Strength, Dexterity). Attribute names are written in lowercase (e.g. strength) and used in dice expressions like 1d20+strength.
sdv_hint: Define values calculated automatically from attributes (e.g. hit points) — as a formula (e.g. (constitution+strength)/2+5) or a table (input sum → value). The formula builder inserts attributes as @{name} — equivalent to bare names (@{mut} = mut); allowed: + - * / ( ), floor(), min()/max(), round(). With requiresTrait the value only applies with that trait (e.g. astral points for spellcasters only). Derived values appear on the character sheet and drive probe thresholds, combat targets and resource maxima.
s5a_hint: Define active (usable: with AP cost and dice expression/damage) and passive (permanent: fixed bonus) abilities. Columns per row: name, category, costs (AP/MP), dice (e.g. 1d8+2), damage type, effect formula. Formulas may use attributes and derived values and are evaluated automatically on use (combat + character sheet). Derived values (e.g. an attack value) can be referenced in rolls — they serve as threshold/target once the system configures them so (attack gate).
s6_hint: Define how characters advance. Level table: XP thresholds plus features per level (generic via progression.levels). The view adapts to your selection under system character.
s6_level_hint: Define experience points and features per level.
s6_xp_hint: Define how much XP improving individual skills costs. The columns (e.g. A/B) are cost curves from the advancement matrix — each skill picks its column there (“talent (A)” = curve A).
s6_imp_hint: Define skills improved via advancement rolls: successful roll → +1 skill value (or table value). No entries means no random advancement.
s7_magic_hint: Basics of the magic system. Mana formula (e.g. astral points from attributes) plus optional requiresTrait (e.g. spellcasters only) or slot values (slot_1 … as derived values + restore rule): the two do not exclude each other — each skill picks exactly one resource (mana or slots) with a cost in its casting. Schools/disciplines are organizational only.
s7_psionics_hint: Define the basics of your psionics system.
s8_hint: Define conditional bonuses applied automatically. E.g. if Strength > 15, +2 to damage or each point of Intuition above 8 gives +1 to Initiative.
s3_hint: Skills are linked to attributes. Choose one or more attributes per skill — order determines weighting. Add more with + attribute. The cost column (e.g. A/B) picks the curve from the advancement matrix (talent purchase costs), activation cost applies once at value 0. Casting turns the skill into a spell: resource (mana/slot) + cost + optional trait + restore rule. Description explains the skill on the character sheet (tooltip).
s4_probe_hint: Probe expression per dice system: 1d20+mod (one d20 plus modifier vs target — D&D style), 3d20 (three separate rolls, each vs an attribute threshold — DSA style; +mod shifts thresholds, mod = attribute modifier + skill + conditions), 1d100 (roll under skill value — CoC style). Display note: with 3d20 the individual dice count, the shown total is informational only — expand details on the probe.
s4_ap_hint: AP (Action Points): Each combat action costs AP. AP Standard = AP per round, AP Max = maximum storable AP (e.g. for saving up). Typical: 2 Standard / 4 Max.
spk_hint: Packages bundle attribute mods, auto-traits and AP costs (e.g. species/culture/profession). Choice groups (e.g. “MU,KK” or “*”) let the player choose. Prefer picking auto-traits from the trait list (dropdown suggestions). Recommended/restricted steer selection hints. Base values are free starting values (floors) for attributes/skills — only buying above them costs AP.
s8_states_hint: Conditions from the catalog apply immediately and always while active: probe effects as penalty/bonus on probes, damage on damage. Rounds tick in combat on the bearer's turn (no rounds: permanent until removed). blocks locks action types in combat (e.g. ATTACK, MOVE, DEFEND, MANEUVER, ABILITY). Conditions are assigned manually (character sheet/DM), by combat/social effects or adventures — there are no prerequisites: whoever has it, feels it.
s8_social_hint: Skill probe + relationship modifier; success/failure applies conditions to the target (ADR-013).
s4_attack_hint: Optional: attack must reach the defender’s target value or no damage is dealt.
s4_difficulties_hint: Optional named levels (× = multiplier, Δ = shift).
s4_resting_hint: Short and long rest per system: Heal % is a fraction of maximum from 0 to 1 (0.5 = half), full heal restores everything. Recover additionally refills resources (mana/slots) per their restore rule (short/long). Without config, resting does nothing — set at least one option.
s3_description_hint: Explains the skill to players on the character sheet.
st_description_hint: Explains to players what the trait does rules-wise.
spk_autotraits_hint: Prefer picking traits from the list above (dropdown suggestions).
